newsitem.title: USA: Ford increases rebate on Taurus to $1,500.
newsitem.headline: Ford increases rebate on Taurus to $1,500.

text.p: Ford Motor Co announced a round of incentive increases Monday, including a $1,500 rebate on the Taurus sedan, up from the previous amount of $1,000.
Ford also said it will offer a $500 rebate on the Escort ZX2, a new sporty coupe introduced in April.
The rebates and financing incentives are part of a national program that runs from July 8 through October 1.

The U.S. No. 2 automaker doubled the rebate to $1,000 for its 1997 and 1998 versions of the Ford Contour and its Mercury sister car, the Mystique. A Ford Aerostar now comes with a $1,500 rebate, up from $1,000.
Ford left unchanged the $1,000 rebate on the 1997 and 1998 Windstar minivans, Escort small car, and Ranger compact pickup. The Mercury Villager minivan also continues with its $2,000 rebate.
Buyers can apply the cash rebates to purchases or 24-month leases. They can also opt for financing rates ranging from 1.9 percent to 5.9 percent on loans of 48 to 60 months.
According to the July 7 edition of Automotive News, a trade magazine, previous financing rates ranged from 1.9 percent to 7.9 percent.
